name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 4 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 21 hours starting 2025-06-22, at wavelengths from 1.25 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
